g.text: The Container view of the Webshop: a single-page application, a modular monolith (ADR-0002) and its PostgreSQL database (ADR-0003), the RabbitMQ message broker (ADR-0006), and the Order Service extracted from the monolith with its own Order Database, which integrates with Stripe (ADR-0004, ADR-0007).
